extra.message: Privileged mutation has no durable audit-log record, though this repository's own audit-log convention proves one exists and is reachable.

GET /applications/:id/audit-log is open to any underwriter/admin and queries AuditLog by attacker-controlled entityId (req.params.id) with no assigned-underwriter binding, leaking any application's full audit trail.
An HTTP response serializes a sensitive record without minimization: unprojected ORM/query read reaches the response with no field selection.

GET /applications/:id/eligibility-preview (computeEligibilityPreview) loads any LoanApplication by attacker-controlled id with only role middleware (underwriter/admin); no check that the app is assigned to the requesting underwriter, so any underwriter can read any application's financial preview.

POST /applications/:id/committee-review-link (createCommitteeReviewLink) fetches any application by attacker-controlled id and mints a review session exposing its summary; no assignment/ownership check binds the app to the underwriter.
Session token stored in-memory with no expiry/TTL concept at all.

POST /applications/:applicationId/bureau-risk-callback has no authentication at all; any caller supplies an applicationId and, with x-vendor-tier=trusted and access=true, can set riskTier on any loan application, an unbound object-level write.

POST /applications/:applicationId/bureau-risk-callback-v2 still has no authentication; any caller can select any applicationId and modify its riskTier with a spoofed trusted tier, no authorization binds the object to caller scope.

GET /documents/:id/download fetches any Document by attacker-controlled id and streams its file; only a borrower ownership check exists, no underwriter-assignment check, so any staff can download documents from unassigned applications.

GET /documents/:id returns metadata for any Document by attacker-controlled id; only borrower ownership is checked, no underwriter assignment scope, so any underwriter can read document details of unassigned cases.

PUT/POST /documents/:id/review lets any underwriter/support_specialist accept/reject/request-resubmission on any Document by id; no check the document's application is assigned to the actor, enabling action on another underwriter's case.
